scale.how: Measured on the board's tree panel (858 x 1281 px). 13 px per inch if the tree's visible height (tip to floor, about 1,120 px) is 7.5 ft; 20 px per inch if its visible width is a real 52" tree. The board is AI-generated and not drawn to scale, so each element is given as a range.

topper.board_desc: Natural burlap bow, two big loops and two tails, black paw prints, wired edges. About 310 px wide on the board.

considered.name: 6 rolls of paw-print ribbon, 1.5-2.5" (the original pick)
considered.why: Mostly black or white backgrounds and only 1.5-2.5" wide; only one roll is close to burlap.

considered.name: White ribbon with black paws, 2.5"
considered.why: White background, not natural burlap; reads as a different bow from across the room.

considered.name: Black burlap ribbon, 4" x 20 yd
considered.why: Right width, wrong colour: black.

considered.name: HARFINGTON burlap ribbon 4" x 10 yd
considered.why: The title says burlap but the photo is black mesh. Listed here because it looked like a backup from its title.

considered.name: Natural burlap wired ribbon 4" x 20 yd
